# DeskGame.xyz

> DeskGame.xyz is an independent website for playing and learning about the 2048 merge puzzle and other free browser games.

## Primary page

- [Play 2048 Online](https://deskgame.xyz/): Play the self-developed 2048 game with three board sizes (3x3, 4x4, 5x5), keyboard and touch controls, score tracking and local best score storage.

## Guides and site information

- [Latest Guides](https://deskgame.xyz/news.html): Strategy guide for reaching 2048 and higher tiles.
- [About DeskGame.xyz](https://deskgame.xyz/about.html): Editorial purpose, game ownership and correction policy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://deskgame.xyz/privacy.html): Analytics, advertising, cookies and browser-game local data practices.
- [Terms of Use](https://deskgame.xyz/terms.html): Conditions for using the site and games.
- [Contact and Support](https://deskgame.xyz/contact.html): Support scope and site information.

## Key facts

- 2048 is a free single-player browser puzzle game developed by DeskGame.xyz.
- Players slide tiles on a grid, merge matching numbers, and aim to reach 2048.
- Three board sizes: 3x3 Sprint (win at 512), 4x4 Classic (win at 2048), 5x5 Expert (win at 4096).
- The game runs entirely in the browser with no third-party embed, no account, and no download.
- Best scores are saved in the browser's local storage only.
